headline: First Tanker of Russian Diesel Sets Sail for the U.S.
summary: A tanker transporting Russian diesel to the United States has departed under a new import agreement, the Kremlin stated.
why: Refined product shipments between major producers and consumer nations influence regional fuel crack spreads and transport costs.

impacts.name: Refining
impacts.why: Inflow of imported diesel adds supply to the domestic market, influencing distillate margins.
